en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a rugged mountain landscape with steep rocky cliffs. A narrow path winds along the mountainside with several hikers or mountaineers walking with sticks. The handwriting at the top identifies the location as 'Passo della Sega alta (gruppo di Brenta)'. The postcard has an old, early 20th-century appearance, with rounded corners and a white border.
